hero.title: Hi, I'm Junior
hero.description:
Java Backend Developer | Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, Angular

I build RESTful APIs, microservices, and integrations with Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JWT/OAuth2, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Docker, applying Clean Code, SOLID, automated testing, and software quality best practices.

about.title: About Me
about.text:
I am a Java Backend Developer with 2.5 years of hands-on experience developing applications with Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Docker. Throughout my journey, I have built more than 5 complete applications, including e-commerce projects, REST APIs, and microservices-based architectures.

I created a BFF project integrated with 4 microservices using OpenFeign, implemented more than 10 RESTful APIs with business rules and data persistence, modeled more than 5 relational and NoSQL databases, and documented complete projects with Swagger/OpenAPI. I aim to contribute to scalable, secure, high-quality solutions by applying Clean Code, SOLID, and layered architecture.
